name: Nunnington Farm Camp Site
accommodation: Tent, tourer and motorhome pitches, many with electric
dogs: Dogs welcome on leads; off-lead area on the farm
beachAccess: A short distance from West Wittering village and its beach
confirmedFeatures: Three toilet blocks, hot showers, laundry, free Wi-Fi, play park; open Easter to mid-October
overview: An independent, family-managed campsite on a flat five-acre field in West Wittering, a short distance from the village and its beach. Many pitches have hook-ups and there are three toilet blocks and free Wi-Fi.
surfTripFit: Close to West Wittering's beach for summer sessions, with simple camping facilities.
